title: ProbeOutput
description: Output of `--probe` (v0.9.9 GAP-WS-PROBE-403-001 / PROBE-SCHEMA-001). Wire keys: English default (v1.0.2 / ADR-0027); PT aliases accepted on deserialize. v1.0.4 closed the object: this file was the only one of the 23 published schemas with `additionalProperties: true`, and that escape hatch was hiding `deep_research_budget`, which `probe::emit_probe_payload` attaches to every probe envelope. `required` also grew from 3 to 8: `ProbeReport` marks those eight fields non-`Option`, so `skip_serializing_none` can never omit them, and declaring only 3 let an envelope missing `endpoint` or `latency_ms` validate.

status.description: ok when SERP-capable; blocked on interstitial/unhealthy; error when the probe never reached a verdict (no Chrome, launch or transport failure). v1.0.3 added `error`: those paths previously emitted the integer 0 here, which no consumer could branch on, and aligns the vocabulary with probe-deep.

http_status.description: Optional numeric HTTP-like code (200 when healthy).
